Website Layout & Display Repair

Broken Website Repair for Layout, Display and Responsive Issues

Is your website suddenly displaying incorrectly? A broken layout can make pages difficult to read, hide important content, affect mobile usability, and create a poor experience for visitors. Problems can appear after a WordPress, theme, plugin, or builder update—or because of CSS conflicts, caching issues, or changes to website files.

Our broken website repair service helps diagnose and fix layout, display, and responsive problems. Whether you have a broken website layout, an Elementor website broken after an update, or pages with CSS and mobile display issues, we investigate the cause and work to restore proper functionality.

Same-Day Support Available | Layout Diagnosis | WordPress Repair | No Upfront Payment for Eligible Projects

Broken Layouts

Fix pages displaying incorrectly or out of alignment

WordPress & Builders

Support for WordPress, Elementor, Divi, and other website builders

Mobile Issues

Repair responsive and mobile layout problems

After-Update Fixes

Diagnose websites broken after updates or changes

Book a Free Consultation

Since 2013

Website repair & SEO recovery experience

1,000+ Websites

Repaired across multiple industries

24/7 Support

Emergency help — call or text anytime

Since 2013

Houston-based, serving clients nationwide

What Causes a Website Layout to Break?

A website may look broken for many different reasons. Sometimes the problem affects one page, while in other cases the entire website displays incorrectly.

Common causes include:

  • WordPress core updates
  • Plugin or theme updates
  • Elementor or Divi conflicts
  • CSS layout problems
  • JavaScript errors
  • Cache or CDN conflicts
  • Missing or corrupted CSS files
  • Theme customization errors
  • Plugin compatibility issues
  • Incorrect website optimization settings
  • Recent website migration
  • Changes to templates or page builder settings

A website that looked correct yesterday can sometimes break after an automatic update or a change made elsewhere in the website. Our first step is to diagnose what is causing the website display problems before applying a fix.

How We Work

Our process is clear, efficient, and built around your needs

01

Free Consultation

We start by reviewing your site and identifying the problems — whether it’s SEO, loading speed, DNS errors, or broken features.

02

Live Diagnosis

We schedule a live session (via phone, Zoom, or Google Meet) to walk you through the issues and explain what needs fixing.

03

Secure Backup

Before making any changes, we take a complete backup of your site to ensure your data is protected.

04

Fast Repairs

Most issues are resolved within 1–3 business days. We fix, test, and verify every change for full functionality.

05

Ongoing Support

After the job is done, we offer guidance, reports, and optional ongoing support to keep your site running strong.

Website Layout Repair for WordPress, Elementor and Divi

Our website layout repair service supports businesses dealing with broken pages, distorted sections, missing elements, or unexpected changes to how their website looks.

WordPress Layout Repair

WordPress layout issues can result from theme conflicts, plugin updates, template changes, caching, or custom code problems. We investigate the affected areas and work to restore the intended layout.

Elementor Website Broken?

If your Elementor page is not loading correctly, sections have shifted, widgets are missing, styles have disappeared, or the editor and front end are showing different layouts, we can investigate the issue.

Our WordPress layout repair service can help identify conflicts involving Elementor settings, plugins, themes, generated CSS, caching, templates, and responsive configurations.

Divi Website Broken?

A Divi website can experience layout issues after updates, module changes, theme conflicts, caching problems, or custom CSS modifications. We review the affected pages and identify the likely source of the problem before making corrections.

CSS Layout Problems

Incorrect or conflicting CSS can cause sections to overlap, disappear, stretch, move out of position, or display differently across devices. We can diagnose CSS-related issues and correct the code or configuration affecting the page.

Is Your Website Layout Broken Right Now?

Don’t spend hours trying random fixes that could create additional problems. Tell us what changed and which pages are affected, and we can help diagnose the issue.

Mobile Layout and Responsive Website Repair

A website may look correct on a desktop but display poorly on a phone or tablet. Mobile layout issues can affect navigation, text, images, buttons, forms, and other important page elements.

We help diagnose and repair problems such as:

  • Sections overlapping on mobile
  • Text extending outside the screen
  • Images displaying at the wrong size
  • Broken columns and spacing
  • Hidden or missing content
  • Navigation problems
  • Buttons that are difficult to use
  • Different layouts across devices
  • Elementor responsive setting issues
  • CSS conflicts affecting mobile screens

Our goal is to restore a layout that works properly across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

Fixing Website Layout Problems After Updates

If your website broke after an update, the problem may involve WordPress, a plugin, theme, page builder, or another website component. Updates are important, but compatibility conflicts can occasionally affect how pages display.

We review what changed and investigate the affected website components.

Our repair process may include:

  1. Identifying the affected pages
    We check where the layout or display problem is occurring.
  2. Reviewing recent changes
    We investigate recent updates, plugin changes, theme modifications, or configuration changes.
  3. Finding the source of the conflict
    We check for compatibility issues, CSS problems, caching conflicts, or other technical causes.
  4. Repairing and testing the layout
    After making the necessary corrections, we test the affected areas across relevant screen sizes.
  5. Checking for related problems
    We review other important pages to identify whether the same issue is affecting additional parts of the website.

Get in touch

  • (+1) 832 266 7209
  • info@fixwebsiteissues.com
  • Houston, Texas — serving all 50 states
Free Consultation

Why WevTEC

  • No deposit — pay after it's fixed
  • Pay only after the work is done
  • Complete backup before any change
  • No long-term contracts
Getting Started

Quick and hassle-free from the first call

Getting your WordPress website repaired is quick and hassle-free. Simply call us at 832-266-7209, or submit your contact information — and we’ll get back to you promptly.

Once we connect, we’ll schedule a live website review with you, either by phone, Zoom, or Google Meet (whichever works best). During this session, we’ll:

  • Review your website in real-time

  • Identify and explain the issues you’re facing

  • Provide a clear solution and expected timeline

  • Begin work immediately — after taking a full backup of your current website

We prioritize secure and transparent repairs, ensuring your website data and functionality are fully protected throughout the process. As a trusted USA-based website repair service, we understand how important your site is to your business — and we treat every repair with the urgency and care it deserves.

Speak to a Website Expert Now
FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions About Broken Website Layout Repair

Still have questions?

Call or text us anytime — real experts, 24/7.

(832) 266 7209
Why is my website layout suddenly broken?

A broken layout can result from plugin, theme, WordPress, or page builder updates. CSS conflicts, caching issues, missing files, custom code, and recent website changes can also cause display problems.

Can you fix an Elementor website that is broken?

Yes. We can investigate Elementor issues involving shifted sections, missing widgets, styling problems, editor and front-end differences, responsive settings, generated CSS, plugin conflicts, and theme compatibility.

Can you fix mobile layout issues?

Yes. Our website layout repair service can address problems involving overlapping sections, incorrect spacing, oversized images, broken columns, hidden content, and other mobile display issues.

My website broke after an update. Can it be repaired?

In many cases, yes. We review the recent update and affected components to identify whether a plugin, theme, WordPress update, page builder, or compatibility conflict caused the issue.

How quickly can you repair a broken website layout?

The repair time depends on the cause and complexity of the problem. Minor website display problems may be resolved quickly, while more complex conflicts or custom code issues can require additional investigation.

Will fixing my layout and speed help my SEO?

It can help. Google uses page experience signals such as mobile usability and Core Web Vitals, including layout shift. A clean, stable, fast-loading layout also keeps visitors on the page longer. Rankings depend on many factors, so we don’t promise specific positions.

Will my website stay live while you fix it?

Yes, in most cases. We take a full backup first and apply fixes carefully, testing on staging when the change is risky, so visitors are not disrupted.

Can you also fix slow loading caused by the layout?

Yes. We optimize images, script loading, caching and page-builder output that cause both display problems and slow pages. For a full performance project, see our website speed optimization page.

Common Website Display Problems We Fix

Our broken website repair service can help with a wide range of layout and display issues.

Broken Sections and Page Elements

Sections may shift, overlap, disappear, or display with incorrect spacing. We investigate the underlying cause and restore the intended layout where possible.

Missing Styles and Formatting

When CSS files fail to load or styles are overwritten, a website can suddenly appear unformatted. We review the affected files, builder settings, and website configuration.

Header and Footer Problems

A broken header, menu, footer, or global template can affect the entire website. We help diagnose issues involving templates, theme settings, and page builder configurations.

Website Looks Different on the Front End

Sometimes a page looks correct inside Elementor or another builder but displays differently to visitors. This may be caused by caching, generated CSS, optimization plugins, theme conflicts, or other settings.

Layout Changes After Plugin or Theme Updates

If a recent update changed your website appearance, we can investigate compatibility issues and determine the safest approach to repair the affected layout.

Broken Pages After Website Changes

Website redesigns, migrations, new plugins, custom code, and other changes can create unexpected display problems. We review the affected pages and identify what needs to be corrected.

Our Website Layout Repair Process

We start by identifying what changed and where the problem is occurring. Instead of applying random fixes, we review the affected layout and investigate the technical cause.

Diagnose the Problem

We check the affected pages, website builder, theme, plugins, recent updates, CSS, and relevant settings to identify the likely source of the issue.

Repair the Broken Layout

Once the cause is identified, we correct the relevant layout, styling, template, or configuration issue.

Check Responsive Display

We review the repaired pages across desktop, tablet, and mobile layouts to identify obvious responsive problems.

Test Important Website Functions

After the repair, we check important elements such as navigation, buttons, forms, images, and page sections to make sure the affected area is functioning properly.

 

Why Fix a Broken Website Layout Quickly?

A broken layout can affect how visitors view and use your website. Important information may be hidden, forms may become difficult to complete, and mobile visitors may leave if pages are not displaying properly.

Quick website layout repair can help restore:

  • Professional website appearance
  • Clear and usable page layouts
  • Mobile responsiveness
  • Important content visibility
  • Navigation and user experience
  • Proper display of forms and calls to action

Whether your Elementor website is broken, your Divi layout changed, or your WordPress website developed unexpected display problems, we can investigate the issue.

Need Broken Website Repair?

Tell us which pages are affected and whether the problem started after an update, website change, migration, or other event. Our team can review the issue and discuss the appropriate repair.

Get Your Website Layout Checked

Call +1 (832) 266-7209 for website repair support and an initial diagnosis.

Layout Problems That Also Slow Your Site Down

Layout and speed problems often share the same cause. Shifting sections, oversized images, render-blocking scripts and heavy page-builder markup make a page look broken and load slowly. Google measures this directly through Core Web Vitals, including Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS), which tracks how much content jumps around while a page loads.

When we repair a broken layout, we also check:

  • Layout shift (CLS) caused by images, fonts, ads or late-loading sections
  • Oversized or unoptimized images that push content around
  • CSS and JavaScript conflicts from themes, plugins and page builders
  • Caching or minification settings that break styles after an update
  • Mobile rendering on real phone and tablet sizes

If your main problem is load time rather than display, see our website speed optimization service. For one-off fixes with fixed prices, see our website repair pricing.

Is Your Website Layout Broken and Costing You Visitors?

Tell us what changed and which pages are affected, and we can diagnose the problem and help restore your website’s layout as quickly as possible.

Let's Have A Free Consultation

Call or text us — we’ll review your website live and give you a clear plan and a free, no-obligation quote.

(832) 266 7209 — Call Now
